SEU observes Martyred Intellectuals Day
2021-12-21T18:01:53+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/shout/bulletin-board/news/seu-observes-martyred-intellectuals-day-2922521

Southeast University (SEU) observed Martyred Intellectuals Day with due solemnity on the campus. A discussion programme was held with SEU VC Prof. Dr. AFM Mafizul Islam as the programme chair on December 21. Adviser to BoT, SEU Trust, Prof. Dr. ANM Meshquat Uddin was the discussant.

Historian and Bangabandhu Chair Professor, BUP Prof. Dr. Syed Anwar Hossain addressed the programme as the chief guest.

Dean of the School of Arts & Social Sciences, SEU Prof. Dr. M. A. Hakim delivered the welcome speech. Members of the BoT, Registrar, Deans, Chairmen, faculty members, and SEU officials attended the program. Students also attended the program through Facebook Live.
